description: Canonical ConflictError (409) corpus. HTTP 409 surfaces as the SDK's ConflictError (a ServerError subclass in the parity taxonomy when no dedicated ConflictError exists; the parity contract pins the Go reference which exposes a dedicated ConflictError). Covers invalid lifecycle transitions, inactive-agent capability issuance, delegation depth ceiling, and idempotency-key conflicts.

cases.name: invalid_transition
cases.message: The requested lifecycle transition is invalid for the current status.
cases.parity_note: The body includes current_status so the SDK can surface it. A follow-up customers.get shows the status unchanged.

cases.name: agent_not_active
cases.message: The agent is not active; capability issuance requires an active agent.

cases.name: delegation_depth_exceeded
cases.message: The parent capability has no remaining delegation depth; a child cannot be minted.
cases.trigger: delegate() from a parent whose max_delegation_depth is 0.

cases.name: idempotency_key_conflict
cases.message: An Idempotency-Key was replayed with a different request body.
cases.trigger: customers.create({name:'A'}, Idempotency-Key: K) then customers.create({name:'B'}, Idempotency-Key: K).

sdk_mapping.parity_taxonomy_note: Where a language has no dedicated ConflictError, the SDK surfaces a ServerError subclass whose .status == 409 and .code == the canonical string. The Go reference exposes ConflictError; TS/Python mirror it.
